change_reason: Attempt 001 compared a population ATE interval with individual pair effects. That quantity is an individual-effect residual, not confidence-interval coverage or ATE estimation error.

scoring_estimand.unit: unique split and topology-family population for each method/configuration
scoring_estimand.target: mean paired reroute-minus-keep latency effect over original observed opportunities
scoring_estimand.exclusions: controlled metadata-fault clones are excluded from target construction
scoring_estimand.coverage: one indicator that the population mean paired effect lies within the method's ATE interval
scoring_estimand.individual_effect_residual: retained as diagnostic only and never labelled ATE estimation error or interval coverage

metric_overrides.reason: Estimate minus mean paired population effect at the estimator's declared ATE grouping unit.
Coverage compares each ATE interval with the corresponding mean paired population effect, never an individual effect.
Width is reported once per distinct ATE interval and population target.
